target.title: QA-lab credentials-admin response bound
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

`postJson` in `extensions/qa-lab/src/qa-credentials-admin.runtime.ts` read the full credential broker response with `response.text()`. An unexpectedly large response could exhaust memory.

## Why This Change Was Made

The response body is now read through `readResponseWithLimit` (via `openclaw/plugin-sdk/response-limit-runtime`) with a 1 MiB cap. The bounded read is included in the existing request try/catch so overflow errors are surfaced as `QaCredentialAdminError` with code `BROKER_REQUEST_FAILED`.

## User Impact

QA credential admin operations (add/list/remove) fail safely on oversized broker responses instead of buffering unbounded memory.

## Evidence

- Regression test added in `extensions/qa-lab/src/qa-credentials-admin.runtime.test.ts` feeds an oversized response and asserts it is rejected with the size-bound error.
- Real behavior proof script in `scripts/proof/qa-lab-credentials-admin-response-bound.mts` starts a local HTTP server returning a 20 MiB body and shows the bounded read rejecting before OOM.

### Local verification commands

```bash
pnpm test extensions/qa-lab/src/qa-credentials-admin.runtime.test.ts
OPENCLAW_OXLINT_SKIP_PREPARE=1 node scripts/run-oxlint.mjs \
  extensions/qa-lab/src/qa-credentials-admin.runtime.ts \
  extensions/qa-lab/src/qa-credentials-admin.runtime.test.ts \
  scripts/proof/qa-lab-credentials-admin-response-bound.mts
node --import tsx scripts/proof/qa-lab-credentials-admin-response-bound.mts
```

### Proof script output

```
=== Proof: qa-lab credentials-admin response bound ===

Local server returning 20971520 bytes at http://127.0.0.1:34973

Caught expected error: Convex credential admin request failed: Convex credential admin response exceeds 1048576 bytes (1111652 bytes)

PASS: oversized credential admin response was rejected before OOM.
```
